name: Scarred Blacksteel Bascinet 2026
prompt: Make one medieval knight bascinet HELMET as an editable three-dimensional wearable armor prop. Build its head-sized rounded tapering skull of forged dark black steel, a continuous curved steel brow, a hinged pointed face visor with a narrow horizontal viewing slit, overlapping swept cheek protectors, a raised central nasal rib, small punched breathing perforations, and a rolled neck rim. Add realistic high-metallic gunmetal material with polished edge highlights, irregular recessed hammer dents, diagonal blade gouges, rubbed silver scratches, and dark oxidation around the hinges and rivets. The main shape is a hollow helmet shell fitting over a head. Create an original steel armor mesh, save the Blender scene and a rendered PNG, and open this model in Blender's interactive viewport.
